title: Gaza agency says 11 killed in Israeli strikes as IDF confirms it has begun ‘wave of attacks’ – Middle East crisis live
summary: Ceasefire close to total collapse as Israeli military says it has launched strikes in response to ‘blatant violation’ of agreement by Hamas Israeli airstrikes on Gaza as ceasefire comes under threat Freed Israeli hostage David Cunio received a hero’s welcome in the city of Yavne , where residents lined the streets waving Israeli and American flags as he was driven from hospital to rejoin his family, The Times of Israel reports. Cunio, who was abducted from kibbutz Nir Oz with his family during the 7 October 2023 Hamas attack , leaned out of the car window to shake hands and thank supporters as music played and people applauded.
